query: How many organisations are currently listed as signatories on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice signatory page (digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/ai-code-practice) as of July 2026? List the count and names if possible.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary:

## Answer

As of July 2026, the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice signatory page lists **23 organisations as full signatories**, plus **xAI** as a partial signatory (Safety and Security Chapter only) — so the count is **23 (full)** or **24 (including xAI)**. The list on the page carries a "last updated" date of **23 April 2026**.

**The 23 full signatories:**
Accexible · AI Studio Delta · Aleph Alpha · Almawave · Amazon · Anthropic · Black Forest Labs · Bria AI · Cohere · Domyn · Dweve · Fastweb · Google · IBM · Lawise · LINAGORA · Microsoft · Mistral AI · Open Hippo · OpenAI · Pleias · ServiceNow · WRITER

**Plus:** xAI (Safety and Security Chapter only)

**Key caveats:**
- **Meta declined to sign**, calling the Code an "overreach."
- The list was **cross-validated** against the official EU printable PDF, a Baker Botts mirror of the page, and secondary compliance reporting — all showing the identical 23-name list.
- **Pending update:** A 22 July 2026 (18:00 CEST) deadline was reported for inclusion on a newly published, expanded signatory list ahead of the 2 August 2026 entry into application. As of access, the page still displayed the 23 April 2026 list, so a larger post-July-22 roster may supersede it later in 2026.
